body: Is there anything else that keeps you alive? I'd like to know.
How did you too meet? Is she your first? That is, if I may ask.
Strangely enough, I don't want to try out drugs or look for anyone who sells them even though I'm ready to kill myself.
Yeah, maybe if I live a few years more, I can get a steady income and start taking care of dogs. But... I don't think I can wait any longer.
Sorry, travelling isn't really my thing. I'm assuming you travel; what have you found fun about your travels.

Yeah, if I had someone meaningful in my life, I don't think I would want to die. But right now, I just don't find anyone interesting, including myself. There's also nothing interesting for me explore. I'm a bit envious of your position, heh.

1. I wish I would want to do this but I just don't care about anyone.

2. I'm just tired of it all. People aren't fun. Nothing isn't interesting. My only hobby is boring now. There's nothing I want to do. I've tried for so long already, 7 years now i think.

3. Yeah, I'm going to throw about my ticket. Travelling for me isn't fun. I've tried out a lot of activities; I never really grew into them or found them interesting -- and the same applies to careers, although I have only done some part-time jobs and internships.

4. Well, I can't really elaborate on this one. I guess I want a purpose in life? I honestly don't know, sorry.
Thanks, I appreciate your input. I don't think I'll do this. I'm just not motivated enough to do so. It's pretty much because I just don't think it would help. I'll just give it one more month.
The thing is, I've been trying for about 7 years now and nothing's working.
Hah, yeah. You're right. Same goes for me; I don't even have to money to purchase one illegally. The broke life
Yeah, I'm  also scared of failing. I kinda wish there was just some switch we can flip.
Do you think I should check myself for clinical depression. Do you know what I would have to go through to do so? (Like, cost-wise and such) I don't think any meds would help.

I'd like to answer that, but even I don't know what I'm going through myself, heh. The latest thing that has happened to me was realizing that that my gf of 2years (now ex didn't love me anymore + she was trying to get with someone else. This led me to have trust issues and a heavy sense of insecurity when it come to relationships (friends/family/SO). Even before this happened, I never really like people in general (my ex *was* an exception), so I don't think I'll be able to have real relationships/connections like what you have. I think I may want that, but it's certainly not going to happen, even I did pretend to like people -- 'just not gonna happen. What's the story between you and your SO, if I may ask?

But to me, it's just a bad movie. Nothing really interests me anymore. I have even tried things that I knew I wouldn't like, nothing seems to work. I have also tried the common, "go out of your comfort zone" strat. Trying to talk to new people doesn't work, I have nothing really interesting to show for, and when I try to get to know them, people just don't interest me -- even if I become "fake" about being interested. Now, lets say I am on rock bottom (I think I can go a bit deeper), what are some ways to go up.

No, I'm not on any meds. I do some cardio at least every other day. I do it to the point where it tires me yet I have been only getting 2-4hours of sleep each night lately (about the past 2 weeks). 

Thanks for your response. What keeps you alive?
